products.name: Windows Hello for Business — Commercial
products.short_description: Kill the password. Deploy phishing-resistant, passwordless Windows sign-in yourself with self-guided, tested steps — for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Replace passwords with phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in

Passwords are the single most-attacked credential in your environment — phished, reused, sprayed, and reset all day long. Windows Hello for Business removes the password entirely, replacing it with a hardware-bound credential unlocked by a PIN or biometric that never leaves the device. There is nothing to phish and nothing to steal.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Windows Hello for Business. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what WHfB is, how Cloud Kerberos Trust works, and exactly which model to use (no PKI, NDES, or per-user certificates).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (licensing, Entra, Intune, TPM, network) with how to verify it and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click Microsoft Intune steps.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — device-readiness discovery, provisioning validation, tenant-wide registration reporting (Microsoft Graph), safe remediation, and hybrid Entra Kerberos enablement.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A measurable move to phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication: fewer help-desk password resets, a stronger Zero Trust and compliance posture, and a faster sign-in your users actually enjoy — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot within a day.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Enable-EntraKerberos.ps1 — (Hybrid only) enable Microsoft Entra Kerberos for Cloud Kerberos Trust
    • WHfB-Discovery.ps1 — Windows Hello for Business device readiness check
    • WHfB-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for stalled Windows Hello for Business enrollment
    • WHfB-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide report of Windows Hello for Business registration via Microsoft Graph
    • WHfB-Validation.ps1 — confirm Windows Hello for Business is provisioned for the signed-in user

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
